title: unittest.makeSuite, findTestCases and getTestCaseNames have been removed
summary: Python 3.13 removed the unittest functions makeSuite(), findTestCases() and getTestCaseNames(), deprecated since Python 3.11, so calls raise AttributeError.
replacement: The matching TestLoader methods: loadTestsFromTestCase(), loadTestsFromModule(), getTestCaseNames()

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-type differences.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
